prTitle: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema
head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found with gh search prs by title. The PR has a single commit equal to the benchmark head (7355f05e6a); it was merged into main as 679f44692d with the same commit message, so the merged code matches the benchmark head.

tps.bug: GroupPermissionsV2.hasPermission passes getResourceTypeResource's result to policyStore.findByResource without a null check, causing an NPE and 500 on group listing and user search when the Groups type resource is missing.
tps.evidenciaOpus: GroupPermissionsV2.java:144-147 uses getResourceTypeResource without a null check, but hasPermission already requires the admin realm resource server, and AdminPermissionsSchema.java:270-275 creates a type resource for every schema type (including the new Groups) when the admin permissions client is set up, so null is not reachable in normal flows; UserPermissionsV2.java:109-111 uses the same pattern.
tps.evidenciaAstra: Existing FGAP V2 realms can lack the newly added Groups resource: the base schema contains only Users and Clients, and server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:250 returns without updating an existing permissions client. The lookup at AdminPermissionsSchema.java:150 can therefore return null. The new services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java:147 passes that null to findByResource, which dereferences it at model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/authorization/StoreFactoryCacheSession.java:938, causing an exception instead of permission denial.
